fn.en: Talk about your hobbies with the -ing form.

can.en: I can talk about my free time with -ing.
can.ru: Я могу рассказать о свободном времени с формой -ing.
can.kk: Бос уақытым туралы -ing формасымен айта аламын.

tip.en: like / love / hate + verb-ing: I love cooking.
tip.ru: like / love / hate + глагол-ing: I love cooking.
tip.kk: like / love / hate + етістік-ing: I love cooking.

items.q: ___ you like going to the cinema?
I love ___ the guitar, but I ___ play well.

lines: In my free time I like [reading|read|to reading] and [listening|listen|to listen] to music.
My sister loves [taking|take|to taking] photos of people. 📷
She [hates|hate|is hate] getting up early at the weekend.
I love [dancing|dance|to dancing], but I [can’t|don’t can|not can] dance well. 💃
[Do|Does|Are] you like [going|go|to going] to the cinema? — Yes, I do. 🎬

items.s: What do you do in your ___ time? 🕰
We go to the ___ twice a month. 🎬
I always listen to ___ in the car. 🎵

items.a: I like reading in the evening
My brother hates playing video games
Do you like going to the cinema

tts: Do you have any hobbies, Anja? Yes. I like swimming and taking photos. What do you take photos of? People, usually. And you? What do you like doing in your free time? Umm — not a lot. Do you go out often? No, I don’t like going out. I like reading and listening to music at home.

items.s: The man likes listening to music.
The man has a lot of hobbies.

acts.title: Music and sport
text: I’m Mark. I like dancing, but I can’t dance very well. 💃
I love listening to music — usually pop music. 🎵
I don’t play sport, but I like watching football on TV. ⚽
My friend Carla loves dancing and she plays sport twice a week.
She hates watching football. She says it’s boring. 👎

items.s: Carla plays sport twice a week.

write.q: Write 6 sentences: two things you like doing, one you love, one you hate, and two about your family. Use -ing.
write.model: I like reading and listening to music in the evening. I love cooking at the weekend. I hate getting up early. My brother likes playing video games. My sister loves dancing, but she can’t dance well.

speak.q: Answer out loud: What do you like doing in your free time? What do you hate doing? Then ask a Do you like…? question.
speak.model: I like taking photos and going to the cinema. I hate getting up early on Saturday. Do you like listening to music?

q.en: How ___ do you swim? — Twice a week.
She ___ drive. She hasn’t got a car.
